original_benchmark.notes: TaxCalcBench at fdfe0db992ae9033f5b8b942633181a3596da64c: 50 TY2025 cases with PDF inputs (10 each: federal, CA, IL, NY, VA) and 51 TY2024 cases with JSON inputs (federal). Upstream makes one model call per case (no agent) and scores the returned form line by line; its leaderboard is per tax year. No exclusions.

harbor_adapter.notes: All 101 upstream cases are adapted, and parity ran on all of them: taxcalcbench-direct@1.0.0 (a Harbor port of upstream's single Responses API call) with openai/gpt-6-luna at thinking level high, 5 runs per side; the run ranges overlap on all four upstream metrics (details in parity_experiment.json and the README). Standard CLI agent, Harbor side only: Codex CLI 0.171.0 with gpt-6-luna, 35.0% strictly correct returns over 100 of 101 tasks. parity_costs: $2.81 for the original side (upstream's LiteLLM estimate, the 6-case sanity check included), about the same for the Harbor side, and $1.32 for the Codex run. registry_benchmark_size is the 101 tasks the dataset PR registers (requested ID column-tax/taxcalcbench, tag v1.0). The expected returns are public, so the agent phase of every task has no network; Harbor allows the model endpoint it resolves for an installed agent.
